meta.method_note: Income tax for 2025-26 from GOV.UK 'Income Tax rates and Personal Allowances' (section 'Previous tax years'); employee National Insurance from HMRC 'Rates and thresholds for employers 2025 to 2026' (annual figures). The allowance falls by £1 for every £2 of income above the taper threshold, as GOV.UK states. Each figure equals the committed ETL edition named in its source (etl/sources/govuk_tax_rates.py), which checks the two documents against each other. National Insurance applies across the UK; Scotland sets its own income tax bands.

sources.title: GOV.UK, Income Tax rates and allowances for previous tax years
sources.gives: personal allowance, its taper, the basic, higher and additional rate bands and rates

sources.title: HMRC, Rates and thresholds for employers 2025 to 2026
sources.gives: employee National Insurance primary threshold, upper earnings limit, main and upper rates
